reviews.snippet: I took my father was kidney issue in January.  The doctor did not firmly advise the best cure. He was very vague in his statements. They performed the fistula surgery for starting the dialysis and made as wait for 3 weeks till it matures. In between, they made us do the scan for the heart to determine if his heart condition was ok to perform catheter dialysis. There was no improvement and I had to admit my father to another hospital as he almost collapsed. They immediately suggested to perform dialysis via catheter. During the examination, it was also found that the fistula surgery was not done properly, hence it never developed and matured. He had to again undergo the fistula surgery for the second time and it matured in 3 weeks. Now, he is having regular dialysis. It was not a good experience for us. They just made money from us. Be careful.

reviews.snippet:
This Asian Institute Hospital is located in the Banjara Hills near the Banjara hills traffic p.s.
This is a nice hospital.
non-covid hospital. Need to wear masks since Covid-19 Pandemic.
parking space is available.
Lifts are there too. 4th floor is the top.
pharmacy , Radiology zone and reception are in the ground floor.
Consultation charges are Rs.750 per patient.
Face masks without filters are allowed if not at the entrance itself they will be provided.
For patients with stable condition will be suggested to Urologist first time and then if required will be suggested to see Nephrologist.
some Washrooms are common for both men and women.
while some are for staff and others for patients.
better know which one before using it.
Footwear must be removed before entering consultaion room.
Also, small chamber like isolation for doctor's space following covid-19 restrictions.
Patient file will be given and it must be retained for next visit.
Insurance claims office is in the first floor.
Also, dialysis treatment is in the same floor.
Canteen and Parking is in the basement.
covid test is also in the basement.
However , Covid test is only done when the doctor has prescribed to the patient and also clearly mentioned in OP card.

Stay safe and healthy!!
Thanks.

reviews.snippet:
We have visited AINU Banjara Hills at least 3 times now for my mother's treatment. Most recently, she was admitted for 3 days in a private cabin for her kidney dialysis sessions, and I stayed with her throughout.
Compared to Apollo, AINU is much better and highly reasonable in terms of expenses. All the medical procedures are kept incredibly simple and hassle-free. The doctors provide excellent treatment, the staffs are exceptionally helpful and warm, and the entire facility is pristine and highly hygienic.
The only area lagging is the patient food quality. Since people come here from all over India and the world, the kitchen needs to offer a more diverse menu. Currently, they serve the same type of South Indian food daily (sambar, vada, dosa) and heavily use onion, garlic, tomato, and curry leaves in every single dish even putting curry leaves in the breakfast omelette.
Aside from the repetitive food, the hospital service, nursing care, and treatment are a perfect 5/5. Highly recommended!
